[quote=tartakum;60306985]Recently, a group called the NC (Nurdic Caliphate) attacked a village near the border in North Tartakum, killing 5 and injuring 14 after a year dormant. The Ministry Of Defence is sending out a small force to deal with these foes and send them back. They will send the ISC and a detachment of the Army.
[spoiler=
[b]ISC Mobilizes[/b]
[sub][/sub]]

The force will be consisted of 2 of the newly Acquired ZTZ-65's from Qianxun, 2 light IFV's from WMW company, a truck with a Reconnisance drone that can drop mortars, and 30 soldiers (Mounted on the ZTZ's, the 2 IFV's, and in a truck). The gear the soldiers are carrying is the newly Aquired MSR snipers and the Signal boosters for the support unit. They will have 3 snipers.

At 6:45 the force mobilizes, heading north towards the approximate area of the village.
At 7:00, they reach the checkpoint 20 minutes away from the village.
At 7:24, they reach the village finding it destroyed and deserted, still smoke from the fight that happened there. They deploy the UAV's, and spot militants in a small town 15 minutes away, with a ZSU.
At 7:50, the troops unload 5 minutes away, and the Snipers creep closer into a good position. The first shots are fired when the snipers pick off 2 Militants armed with Exported AK's, huddling near a sand bag because of the UAV above. At the same time, the UAV drops its first Mortar on another group of 2 militants, Incapacitating them. The ZSU starts firing fervorously at the UAV, but to no avail.
At 8:00, the UAV spots incoming exported BMD's to the town a few miles away. The ZTZ-65's go to intercept.
t 8:05, the first ZTZ-65 spots the one of the BMD's 4,000 meters away, and with surprising accuracy because of great Qianxun Development, the ZTZ-65 destroys the BMD with a shot to its side wall. The Second BMD comes into range and this time the second ZTZ-65 destroys it with a shot to its frontal armor. All the crew scramble out and prepare to engage infantry and armored targets. A nearby infantry unit deploys its Glopnir 4 missile (Fire and forget) and Incapacitates 2 of the Militants. One of the Militants pull out a RPG, and fire it towards the Infantry, unfortunately hitting one. The infantry unit prepares its LMG, and provides heavy support, picking off the other units
At 8:30, the IFV's have been barraging the town with Light Cannon fire and ATGMS. The roofs of the town are rubble and there are holes everywhere from shells. The ZTZ-65 and other Infantry unit are now back and are ready to assault. A fire team sets up on one of the roofs and feverishly fires at the Militants position. An fire team assaults a house, throwing a grenade, incapacitating one of the Militants. The Infantry units fight ally to ally, and miraculously only lose 1 man in the operation. One of the final moments of the battle was when a ZTZ-65 tank spotted a militant in an ally way, and guided by the UAV, launched a HEAT shell right down, combusting the ally way.
At 8:50, the last of the militants have either run away or been picked off. In total, 1 man has died and 3 soldiers have been injured.

The Ministry of Defence Is impressed by the ZTZ-65 tanks, and he takes note. He holds in high regard how well these old tanks performed, and he is perhaps thinking of acquiring more.

[/spoiler]

[nation]Qianxun[/nation]
[nation]WMW Company[/nation]
RP[/quote]
The ULR offers its condolences for this tragic incident. Due to the circumstances and the fact that these militants are able to source armor enough to use three in a small battle, Lavia would like to offer a joint security mission. The mission would entail The RJR and its armored vehicles setting up checkpoints and defensive perimeters around important assets as well as where we can expect these terrorists to strike next.

[quote=tartakum;60309178][b]SWF[/b]
The Ministry of Economics has finally announced that the first Tartakum SWF is in place. It will be called the "National Wealth Fund". This will be used to fund projects in the future, and will be invested in resources, oil, the industry, and the military. The Ministry of Economics has created a board called "Wealth fund Board", and will comprise of high leading individuals in labor and economics. The funding will come from surplus money from resources, and maybe foreign investments. We will set the initial capital to 2 Billion dollars.[/quote]
[b]The Qianxun-Tarta Alliance[/b]

Satisfied with this arrangement, the Energy Cooperation Group would release its assets to the management of the National Wealth Fund. At the same time, the ECG Central Commission would vote to voluntarily dissolve itself to make provision for the ECG's reformation into a new entity: The Tartakum Energy Corporation, to operate under the trade name Tencor. A Board of Directors would be reconstituted for the new regime, 50% Tarta, 25% Qianxun, 25% Elseyro-Vespurian. The ECG's new stock name, TTEC, would appear on the Rolena Stock Exchange to account for this fresh rebrand.

With Tartakum's latest oil and gas corporation now set to begin operations on its own, Qianxun would move to finalize the terms of their alliance agreement with Tartakum, with Qianxun diplomats at Tartakum's temporary embassy mulling over details of their arrangement. After brief discussions between these diplomats and members of the Qianxun Central State Commission, and a supplementary consultation with Qianxun business leaders, it was agreed that Tartakum's offer was sound, and later in the day on 28 November 2025, Qianxun would finalize the terms of their military alliance.

New corporations would spring up in Tarta territory overnight. Almstedt Corporation, Dearborn Bank, but also Qianxun industry leaders like Qunarco, Miwu Group, Zhaoxin Technologies JCG, and Canglu JCG, with many rushing to Bazhrut to set up offices and begin production of resources to feed Tartakum's growing economy. At the same time, the Tarta bordas would appreciate to account for this sudden burst of growth.

However, Qianxun advisors would warn Tarta to prepare for the great shift that was to come. With these new companies flooding into the country, and with Qianxun technology influencing the Tarta agricultural sector to release workers to account for increased productivity, there will be a great movement of workers seeking to find new employment in Rolena and Bazhrut. When that happens, the state must ensure for its people the socialist principle of the right to labor, or else risk the discontent of the many to the benefit of the few.

Elsewhere, SummitONE Solutions would also set up their own offices in Tartakum, but would advertise themselves as a "private security company" only empowered to supply armored cars for banks and security guards for private establishments, with the corporation deliberating hiding their military capabilities to avoid risks of public scrutiny, their technological sector collaborating with Qunarco Group to ensure absolute secrecy.
